WITH mjt AS (
  SELECT jcdetref AS rid,
         MAX(MAX(j1tempval, j2tempval, j3tempval, j4tempval, j5tempval, j6tempval)) AS mjt
  FROM joint_condition
  GROUP BY jcdetref
),
jdi AS (
  SELECT jc.jcdetref AS rid,
         m.mjt AS mjt,
         SUM((jc.j1tempval * 1.0 / m.mjt + jc.j1vibval)
           + (jc.j2tempval * 1.0 / m.mjt + jc.j2vibval)
           + (jc.j3tempval * 1.0 / m.mjt + jc.j3vibval)
           + (jc.j4tempval * 1.0 / m.mjt + jc.j4vibval)
           + (jc.j5tempval * 1.0 / m.mjt + jc.j5vibval)
           + (jc.j6tempval * 1.0 / m.mjt + jc.j6vibval)) / (COUNT(*) * 6.0) AS jdi
  FROM joint_condition jc
  JOIN mjt m ON m.rid = jc.jcdetref
  GROUP BY jc.jcdetref, m.mjt
),
toh AS (
  SELECT operbotdetref AS rid, MAX(totopshrval) AS toh
  FROM operation
  GROUP BY operbotdetref
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT j.rid, j.jdi, j.mjt, t.toh
  FROM jdi j
  JOIN toh t ON t.rid = j.rid
  WHERE j.jdi > 1.5 AND j.mjt > 65 AND t.toh > 5000
),
slope AS (
  SELECT (COUNT(*) * SUM(toh * jdi) - SUM(toh) * SUM(jdi))
         / (COUNT(*) * SUM(toh * toh) - SUM(toh) * SUM(toh)) AS regression_slope
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.rid AS robot_id,
       q.jdi AS joint_degradation_index,
       q.mjt AS max_joint_temperature,
       q.toh AS total_operating_hours,
       (SELECT regression_slope FROM slope) AS jdi_toh_regression_slope
FROM qualifying q
ORDER BY q.jdi DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH robot_metrics AS (
  SELECT o.operbotdetref AS rid,
         d.modelseriesval AS model_series,
         SUM(o.progcyclecount) AS tpc,
         SUM(o.progcyclecount) * 1.0 / SUM(o.cycletimesecval) AS oce,
         AVG(o.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.currprogval) AS n_programs
  FROM operation o
  JOIN robot_details d ON d.botdetreg = o.operbotdetref
  GROUP BY o.operbotdetref, d.modelseriesval
),
program_oce AS (
  SELECT d.modelseriesval AS model_series,
         o.currprogval AS prog,
         o.operbotdetref AS rid,
         SUM(o.progcyclecount) * 1.0 / SUM(o.cycletimesecval) AS oce
  FROM operation o
  JOIN robot_details d ON d.botdetreg = o.operbotdetref
  GROUP BY d.modelseriesval, o.currprogval, o.operbotdetref
),
program_avg AS (
  SELECT model_series, prog, AVG(oce) AS avg_program_oce
  FROM program_oce
  GROUP BY model_series, prog
),
program_rank AS (
  SELECT model_series, prog, avg_program_oce,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY model_series ORDER BY avg_program_oce DESC) AS program_efficiency_rank
  FROM program_avg
),
series_eff AS (
  SELECT model_series,
         MIN(CASE WHEN program_efficiency_rank = 1 THEN prog END) AS most_efficient_program,
         AVG(avg_program_oce) AS avg_program_efficiency
  FROM program_rank
  GROUP BY model_series
)
SELECT rm.model_series,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rm.rid) AS robot_count,
       ROUND(AVG(rm.oce), 2) AS avg_oce,
       ROUND(AVG(rm.n_programs), 2) AS avg_programs_per_robot,
       AVG(rm.tpc) AS avg_tpc,
       json_object('most_efficient_program', e.most_efficient_program,
                   'avg_program_efficiency', e.avg_program_efficiency) AS efficiency_metrics,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rm.oce < 100 AND rm.tpc > 500000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_efficiency_robots
FROM robot_metrics rm
JOIN series_eff e ON e.model_series = rm.model_series
GROUP BY rm.model_series, e.most_efficient_program, e.avg_program_efficiency
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rm.rid) >= 5
ORDER BY avg_oce DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH sis AS (
  SELECT effectivenessrobot AS rid,
         SUM(json_extract(safety_metrics, '$.overloads')
           + json_extract(safety_metrics, '$.collisions')
           + json_extract(safety_metrics, '$.emergency_stops')
           + json_extract(safety_metrics, '$.speed_violations')) AS sis
  FROM performance_and_safety
  GROUP BY effectivenessrobot
)
SELECT d.bottypeval AS robot_type,
       AVG(s.sis) AS avg_sis,
       MAX(s.sis) AS max_sis
FROM sis s
JOIN robot_details d ON d.botdetreg = s.rid
WHERE s.sis > 20
GROUP BY d.bottypeval
ORDER BY avg_sis DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH energy AS (
  SELECT effectivenessrobot AS rid, SUM(energyusekwhval) AS energy_kwh
  FROM performance_and_safety
  GROUP BY effectivenessrobot
),
robot_metrics AS (
  SELECT o.operbotdetref AS rid,
         o.apptypeval AS application_type,
         MAX(o.totopshrval) AS toh,
         e.energy_kwh * 1.0 / MAX(o.totopshrval) AS eer
  FROM operation o
  JOIN energy e ON e.rid = o.operbotdetref
  GROUP BY o.operbotdetref, o.apptypeval, e.energy_kwh
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT rm.*,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY application_type ORDER BY eer DESC) AS eer_rank
  FROM robot_metrics rm
)
SELECT application_type,
       AVG(eer) AS avg_eer,
       MAX(eer_rank) AS worst_eer_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE eer > 0.01 AND toh > 1000
GROUP BY application_type
ORDER BY avg_eer DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH ape AS (
  SELECT actdetref AS rid, AVG(poserrmmval) AS ape
  FROM actuation_data
  GROUP BY actdetref
),
recent_fault AS (
  SELECT rid, faultpredscore AS rfps
  FROM (
    SELECT upkeeprobot AS rid, faultpredscore,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upkeeprobot ORDER BY upkeepduedays ASC) AS rn
    FROM maintenance_and_fault
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
age AS (
  SELECT d.botdetreg AS rid,
         d.ctrltypeval AS controller_type,
         (julianday(r.rects) - julianday(d.instdateval)) / 365.25 AS ray
  FROM robot_details d
  JOIN robot_record r ON r.recreg = d.botdetreg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT g.rid, g.controller_type, g.ray, a.ape, f.rfps,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g.controller_type ORDER BY a.ape DESC) AS ape_rank
  FROM age g
  JOIN ape a ON a.rid = g.rid
  JOIN recent_fault f ON f.rid = g.rid
)
SELECT controller_type,
       AVG(ape) AS avg_position_error,
       MAX(ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank,
       AVG(rfps) AS avg_recent_fault_prediction_score,
       COUNT(*) AS robot_count
FROM ranked
WHERE ape >= 0.1 AND rfps > 0.5 AND ray > 1
GROUP BY controller_type
ORDER BY max_ape_rank DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT rid, cycletimesecval AS recent_cycle_time
  FROM (
    SELECT o.operbotdetref AS rid, o.cycletimesecval,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.operbotdetref ORDER BY r.rects DESC) AS rn
    FROM operation o
    JOIN robot_record r ON r.recreg = o.operrecref
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
robot_metrics AS (
  SELECT o.operbotdetref AS rid,
         d.modelseriesval AS model_series,
         SUM(o.progcyclecount) AS tpc,
         SUM(o.progcyclecount) * 1.0 / SUM(o.cycletimesecval) AS oce,
         AVG(o.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.currprogval) AS unique_programs
  FROM operation o
  JOIN robot_details d ON d.botdetreg = o.operbotdetref
  GROUP BY o.operbotdetref, d.modelseriesval
  HAVING SUM(o.progcyclecount) > 100000
)
SELECT rm.rid AS robot_id,
       rm.model_series,
       rm.oce AS operation_cycle_efficiency,
       rm.tpc AS total_program_cycles,
       rm.avg_cycle_time,
       rm.unique_programs,
       l.recent_cycle_time,
       CASE WHEN rm.oce < 100 AND rm.tpc > 500000 THEN 'Low Efficiency'
            WHEN rm.oce < 150 OR rm.tpc > 300000 THEN 'Medium Efficiency'
            ELSE 'High Efficiency' END AS cycle_efficiency_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rm.model_series ORDER BY rm.oce DESC) AS model_series_efficiency_rank
FROM robot_metrics rm
JOIN latest l ON l.rid = rm.rid
ORDER BY rm.oce DESC, rm.tpc DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH tool AS (
  SELECT effectivenessrobot AS rid,
         AVG(toolwearpct) AS avg_tool_wear_pct,
         SUM(toolwearpct) AS sum_tool_wear_pct
  FROM performance_and_safety
  GROUP BY effectivenessrobot
),
ops AS (
  SELECT operbotdetref AS rid,
         SUM(progcyclecount) AS tpc,
         AVG(cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time
  FROM operation
  GROUP BY operbotdetref
)
SELECT t.rid AS robot_id,
       t.avg_tool_wear_pct,
       t.sum_tool_wear_pct * 1.0 / o.tpc AS tool_wear_rate,
       o.tpc AS total_program_cycles,
       o.avg_cycle_time AS avg_cycle_time_sec,
       CASE WHEN t.sum_tool_wear_pct * 1.0 / o.tpc > 0.001 AND o.tpc > 10000 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN t.sum_tool_wear_pct * 1.0 / o.tpc > 0.0005 OR t.avg_tool_wear_pct > 75 THEN 'WARNING'
            ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS tool_replacement_status
FROM tool t
JOIN ops o ON o.rid = t.rid
ORDER BY tool_wear_rate DESC, total_program_cycles DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH csi AS (
  SELECT systemoverseerrobot AS rid,
         AVG(json_extract(controller_metrics, '$.load_value')
           + json_extract(controller_metrics, '$.thermal_level')) AS csi
  FROM system_controller
  GROUP BY systemoverseerrobot
),
ops AS (
  SELECT operbotdetref AS rid, COUNT(*) AS operation_count
  FROM operation
  GROUP BY operbotdetref
)
SELECT c.rid AS robot_id,
       c.csi AS controller_stress_index,
       COALESCE(o.operation_count, 0) AS operation_count,
       CASE WHEN c.csi > 100 AND COALESCE(o.operation_count, 0) > 2 THEN 'HIGH RISK'
            ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS risk_status
FROM csi c
LEFT JOIN ops o ON o.rid = c.rid
ORDER BY c.csi DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH maint AS (
  SELECT upkeeprobot AS rid,
         SUM(faultpredscore * (1.0 / (1 + upkeepduedays))) / SUM(1.0 / (1 + upkeepduedays)) AS wfps,
         MIN(rulhours) AS mrul
  FROM maintenance_and_fault
  GROUP BY upkeeprobot
),
ops AS (
  SELECT operbotdetref AS rid,
         MAX(totopshrval) AS toh,
         COUNT(*) AS number_of_operations
  FROM operation
  GROUP BY operbotdetref
)
SELECT o.rid AS robot_id,
       m.wfps AS weighted_fault_prediction_score,
       m.mrul AS min_remaining_useful_life,
       o.toh AS total_operating_hours,
       o.number_of_operations,
       CASE WHEN m.wfps > 0.6 AND m.mrul < 500 THEN 'CRITICAL'
            WHEN m.wfps > 0.4 OR m.mrul < 500 THEN 'WARNING'
            ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS maintenance_priority_level
FROM ops o
JOIN maint m ON m.rid = o.rid
WHERE o.toh > 1000
ORDER BY m.wfps DESC, m.mrul ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH sis AS (
  SELECT effectivenessrobot AS rid,
         SUM(json_extract(safety_metrics, '$.overloads')
           + json_extract(safety_metrics, '$.collisions')
           + json_extract(safety_metrics, '$.emergency_stops')
           + json_extract(safety_metrics, '$.speed_violations')) AS sis
  FROM performance_and_safety
  GROUP BY effectivenessrobot
),
recent_fault AS (
  SELECT rid, faultpredscore AS rfps
  FROM (
    SELECT upkeeprobot AS rid, faultpredscore,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upkeeprobot ORDER BY upkeepduedays ASC) AS rn
    FROM maintenance_and_fault
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT s.rid AS robot_id,
       s.sis AS safety_incident_score,
       f.rfps AS recent_fault_prediction_score
FROM sis s
JOIN recent_fault f ON f.rid = s.rid
WHERE s.sis > 20 AND f.rfps > 0.5
ORDER BY s.sis DESC
LIMIT 100
